Launched in 1998, Exotic India was founded by a team with a passion for Indian culture, and a goal to bring together people who love India.

Our passion comes from a desire to share with the world the beauty of India and its unique offerings from all over the country. As lovers of Indian culture ourselves, we recognize the importance of offering a selection that properly represents the diverse regions of India.

And so, we created Exotic India to celebrate India and endeavor to bring all that we love about the country to customers around the globe. We strive to offer products that come from original Indian designs, knowledge, care and skill, with a commitment to sourcing top quality products, unique designs and craftsmanship available.

Today, Exotic India is a dedicated team of 125 people, led by MBAs and Engineers from top Indian Schools. To date, we have shipped to 161 of the 195 countries across the world including far and close places like Belize, Bermuda, and more.

Whether you're just discovering the wonders of India or if you have been a longtime fan of her culture and traditions, at Exotic India we are proud to offer a place for all to discover the true joys and values of India. Welcome!

Navratan Carpets Pvt. Ltd., based in Gwalior, has emerged as one of the prominent companies dedicated to preserving and promoting the city’s rich heritage of hand-knotted carpet weaving. Rooted in generations of craftsmanship, the company specializes in manufacturing handmade woollen and art silk carpets using intricate knotting techniques inspired by Persian artistry and the royal traditions of Gwalior.

The company’s work reflects the highly skilled and labor-intensive weaving process — from yarn dyeing and loom preparation to detailed hand-knotting carried out by experienced artisans. By blending traditional craftsmanship with modern digital outreach, online storytelling, and global market engagement, Navratan Carpets is helping revive international recognition for Gwalior’s centuries-old carpet weaving tradition while also creating sustainable livelihood opportunities for local weaving families.

With a 30-year legacy and two trusted entities — Krish Exports and Krish Cookware LLP — we operate from a state-of-the-art 180,000 sq. ft. facility in Palghar, India. customer’s need.

JFS GLOBAL TRADE is an India-based exporter specializing in sustainable and handmade products. Our journey began with a passion for natural materials, handcrafted artistry, and the desire to contribute to a greener planet. Established in 2021, our company was founded with a vision to promote the exceptional craftsmanship of Indian artisans and provide sustainable alternatives to global markets. 

We connected with local craftsmen and self-help groups across India to uplift their communities and bring their handmade products to global buyers.

With the trust of our clients and dedication of our artisans, we are confident that our growth will continue for years ahead.

Keerthi Nirmal (Keerthi Agro Mills Pvt. Ltd.) is a leading agriculture and processed food company founded in 1998, based in Ernakulam, Kerala, India. With four mills, 700+ employees, and a daily production capacity of over 400 tonnes, the company has an annual turnover exceeding ₹500 crores. We manufacture and distribute 15+ varieties of rice along with jaggery, sugar, salt, coconut oil, and other processed food products. Satva Silver is a premium silver jewelry and fine silverware manufacturing company dedicated to the pursuit of perfection. We specialize in an end-to-end crafting process, maintaining uncompromising quality control from the initial melting of high-grade silver to the intricate detailing performed by our master craftsmen. By bridging the gap between traditional silversmithing and modern operational efficiency, Satva Silver delivers pieces of unparalleled elegance, purity, and structural integrity to our esteemed clients. Our Mission To craft exquisite, high-quality silver jewelry that marries traditional artistry with modern precision. We are committed to providing our clients with timeless, premium pieces that celebrate elegance while maintaining absolute transparency and purity in our manufacturing process. Our Vision To be the industry's most trusted and prestigious manufacturer of fine silver jewelry, recognized globally for our uncompromising quality, dedicated artisan partnerships, and timeless design. We strive to set the gold standard in the silver manufacturing industry. Our History & Heritage Founded byz Sanidhya and Nishant Taliwal, Satva Silver was established with a clear vision: to elevate the standards of silver manufacturing by integrating modern management with heritage craftsmanship. What began as a passion for fine jewelry has evolved into a highly structured operation. By building custom, modernized systems to manage our workflows, we have optimized our entire supply chain. This meticulous organization ensures seamless coordination between our raw material processing, our artisan workshops, and our final client deliveries, allowing the artistry of our silversmiths to take center stage. Unique Aspects of Our Business End-to-End In-House Manufacturing: We oversee the entire lifecycle of our jewelry. By strictly managing the melting and refining processes ourselves, we guarantee the baseline purity of every piece before it even reaches the artisan's bench. Empowered Master Artisans: Our creations are brought to life by dedicated, highly skilled artisans. We provide them with a structured, supportive environment where their traditional techniques can thrive alongside modern quality standards. Technological Precision: Behind our artisanal craft lies a highly modernized operational backbone. We utilize custom-tailored, data-driven systems to track our manufacturing modules, artisan outputs, and client relationships, guaranteeing exceptional reliability and on-time delivery.

Thenga is a homegrown brand from Kerala that repurposes coconut waste into lasting, sustainable and handmade home products. A native of Kerala, Maria was always convinced that coconuts are more than just coconut oil and water. She naturally started looking at the byproducts of coconut processing units and that’s how it all began. From making her first coconut shell bowl to exporting abroad, Maria and Thenga have come a long way. 

Thenga is for the conscious customer. Each piece speaks of the hands that made it. Cut and polished to reveal the grainy detail in the shell, Thenga products are completely natural, safe and sustainable. Coconut shells are tough and inherently hardy, so they last for decades and make perfect substitutes for plastic products. Thenga is all about reusing and repurposing what is traditionally considered “waste.” The team strives to make sure that nothing is left unused at their unit. Thenga products don’t come with the guilt that is innate in mass produced products. By making products close to nature, Thenga hopes to make better choices available to customers.

JK MEDIRISE PRIVATE LIMITED is a prominent, quality-driven healthcare enterprise headquartered in Gujarat, India, specializing in the manufacturing, supply, and global export of high-grade medical devices, surgical consumables, and pharmaceutical solutions. Strategically positioned within India’s rapidly expanding medical technology ecosystem, the company serves as a vital bridge between rigorous manufacturing standards and the evolving demands of global healthcare systems. Guided by a core operational philosophy centered on patient safety and exceptional reliability, JK MEDIRISE caters to an extensive international clientele across diverse geographic regions, delivering precise, cost-effective, and clinically compliant medical consumables.
The corporate headquarters and primary administrative functions are located in Ahmedabad, a major industrial and economic hub in Western India. To support its scaling production capacity and logistical infrastructure, the company maintains key strategic footprints, including corporate presence at Baleshwar Avenue, S.G. Highway, Ahmedabad, and specialized facilities positioned along the Ahmedabad-Mehsana Highway in Nandasan, Mahesana—a region renowned for robust industrial connectivity, reliable power infrastructure, and a skilled manufacturing workforce.

## Core Philosophy: Mission, Vision, and Values

JK MEDIRISE operates not merely as a commercial supplier, but as an active partner to the global healthcare community. The company evaluates its commercial success through the lens of clinical outcomes and the satisfaction of healthcare professionals who rely daily on its products.

* **Motto:** A quality-driven, customer-focused organization.
* **Mission:** Empowering the highest standards of medical care, service reliability, and user safety across international borders.
* **Operational Vision:** To systematically maintain the confidence, clinical satisfaction, and long-term loyalty of global health ministries, hospital networks, and distribution partners by ensuring a zero-compromise approach to product integrity.

## Comprehensive Product Portfolio

The product catalog of JK MEDIRISE spans an extensive array of medical disciplines, focusing heavily on sterile, single-use medical devices and surgical consumables designed to mitigate cross-contamination risks in intensive and general care environments.

### 1. Infusion and Transfusion Therapy Systems

Managing fluid delivery and blood components requires precision-engineered fluid dynamics. JK MEDIRISE supplies a diverse line of administration systems, including:

* **Intravenous (IV) Cannulae / Peripheral Catheters:** Designed with advanced needle-grounding technology to facilitate smooth vein entry, minimizing patient trauma and maximizing dwell performance.
* **Standard Infusion Sets & Micro-Drip Systems:** Equipped with precise flow regulators and fluid filters to ensure accurate, gravity-fed delivery of maintenance fluids and critical medications.
* **Measured Volume Burette Sets:** Vital for pediatric and neonatal care, where volumetric accuracy is paramount to avoid fluid overload.
* **Blood Administration Sets:** Manufactured with specialized filters to safely transfuse blood components while trapping micro-aggregates.
* **Extension and High-Pressure Monitoring Lines:** Ensuring safe, kink-resistant connections between the patient and diagnostic/infusion hardware.

### 2. Urology and Drainage Systems

For long-term and acute urological care, the company provides safe, biocompatible solutions engineered to reduce the risk of Catheter-Associated Urinary Tract Infections (CAUTIs):

* **Urine Collecting Bags (UroBags):** Closed drainage systems featuring anti-reflux valves, clear volumetric markings, and secure sampling ports.
* **Foley Catheters and Male External Catheters:** Produced from premium, medical-grade elastomers to ensure tissue compatibility and minimize mucosal irritation during extended wear.

### 3. Anesthesia, Respiratory, and Intensive Care

In critical care environments where airway management and oxygen delivery are time-critical, JK MEDIRISE provides reliable, single-use respiratory aids:

* **Endotracheal and Thoracic Drainage Tubes:** Designed with optimal structural rigidity to resist collapsing while protecting delicate anatomical structures.
* **Nebulizer Kits and Nasal Oxygen Cannulae:** Engineered for precise aerosolization of therapeutics and comfortable, low-flow oxygen therapy.

### 4. Specialized Surgical Disciplines

Beyond general consumables, the company addresses targeted clinical fields requiring specialized implantable and interventional instruments:

* **Interventional Cardiology:** High-performance accessories, including specialized monitoring lines and guide systems tailored to cardiac catheterization labs.
* **Gastroenterology:** Single-use feeding tubes, aspiration systems, and diagnostic accessories designed to navigate the gastrointestinal tract safely.
* **Dental Implants and Prosthetics:** High-precision components meeting modern dental reconstruction standards.

### 5. General Surgery, Wound Management, and Dressings

To support the foundational needs of operating rooms and triage centers, the company provides a comprehensive line of standard medical disposables:

* **Surgical Dressings and Bandages:** High-absorbency, sterile cotton wools, Gauzes, and fixed dressings optimized for wound exudate management and sterile field maintenance.
* **Surgical Sutures and Disposable Syringes:** Precision-ground needles and reliable syringe bodies built to strict international volumetric tolerances.
* **Protective Wear:** High-barrier medical gloves designed to provide tactile sensitivity alongside robust viral and chemical protection for clinicians.

## Quality Assurance and Regulatory Compliance

In the medical device industry, quality management is directly linked to patient safety. JK MEDIRISE manages its production and sourcing pipelines through stringent internal validation frameworks. The company aligns its operations with universally recognized healthcare benchmarks, ensuring that products possess the necessary certifications to enter highly regulated global markets.

Key quality milestones and compliance standards governing the portfolio include:

* **ISO 13485 Certification:** The definitive global quality management system standard for the medical device industry, ensuring rigorous control from product conception through manufacturing and distribution.
* **CE Marking:** Alignment with European Medical Device Directives and Regulations, certifying that the products meet essential European safety, health, and environmental protection requirements.
* **Strict ITC HS Code Classification:** Seamless customs and regulatory categorization (e.g., Chapter 9018 classifications for electro-medical and surgical appliances) ensuring predictable international freight processing.

## Global Export Footprint and Market Presence

Operating as a specialized merchant exporter from India—a nation rapidly cementing its status as the "Pharmacy of the World"—JK MEDIRISE has built a resilient global supply chain network. The company systematically services an extensive list of international destinations spanning several continents, including emerging markets in Central and South Asia, Eastern Europe, Africa, and the Americas.

By leveraging competitive manufacturing cost structures in India alongside world-class quality systems, JK MEDIRISE provides an ideal alternative for international procurement managers seeking to optimize healthcare budgets without sacrificing clinical efficacy. The company’s logistical operations are built to manage container-load ocean freight, rapid air-cargo deployments for critical care items, and contract manufacturing relationships tailored to the private-label specifications of overseas partners.

## Future Outlook: Sustainability and Innovation

As the global medical device market transitions toward smarter, safer, and more sustainable healthcare delivery, JK MEDIRISE PRIVATE LIMITED is focused on continuous operational enhancement. The company actively explores the integration of eco-friendly, phthalate-free polymers in its disposable lines to reduce the environmental footprint of medical waste. Concurrently, by expanding its research and development perspectives and strengthening its domestic manufacturing alliances within India's dedicated MedTech parks, JK MEDIRISE remains positioned to introduce increasingly sophisticated interventional devices to the international healthcare landscape, safeguarding its role as a trusted partner in global health.

The Beginnings
A belief in the power of imagination led to the birth of “Shrinivas Sugandhalaya”. In India, scents and rituals co-mingle everyday. A whiff of Sandalwood Incense may drive you to go into deep meditation.

In a land where the power of scent is indisputable, Late Shri K.N. Satyam Setty, the founder of “Shrinivas Sugandhalaya” decided to imagine a world of scents for his Love & Passion.

In the year 1964, he established a small incense manufacturing unit, by understanding ancient way of making incense with various fragrances, particular interest to him was a practice used by monks in medieval times whereby the key incense ingredients were incorporated and massaged into a special container resin which was then hand-rolled into incense. This technique called “Masala” or “Flora” incense became the prime driver of production at Shrinivas Sugandhalaya (the other technique, known as “charcoal” incense literally involves dipping the unscented stick directly into the ingredient mixture). Over the years, “masala” incense has established itself to a global audience as lasting longer and stronger than its “dipped” counter part and Satyam Setty became the contemporary “King of Masala Incense”.

Satyam Setty was a keen innovator and used his power of imagination to evoke powerful moods through his recipe blends. One of the best blends from the house was the “Satya Sai Baba Nag Champa”, which is the most sought after and commercially successful masala/flora incense blend across the world.

A New Chapter
While Satyam Setty revolutionised “Shrinivas Sugandhalaya”, his son Shri K.S. Balakrishna Setty joined him & was trained by him. Acquainted with the manufacturing process, Balakrishna Setty strove to combine his innovative, genius and creativity with the high standards of the original manufacturing process with the key of purity & quality ingredients. It was his father’s belief & trust in him that made Shri K.S. Balakrishna Setty to invent a new fragrance hand rolled Agarbatti aptly called “SUPER HIT”. As NAG CHAMPA & SUPER HIT came to be loved across the world, with its success “Shrinivas Sugandhalaya” Incenses became popular for their signature purifying capacities.

In 2014, our Company “Shrinivas Sugandhalaya (BNG) LLP” raised its head under the Management headed by his son Shri Balakrishna Setty by setting up the manufacturing units in Bengaluru, India.

The Customers / end users are treated to a corpus of new and evolving products from the house of “Shrinivas Sugandhalaya (BNG) LLP”.

The Legacy set forth by the founder Late Shri K.N. Satyam Setty will now be carried forwarded by his grandson Shri. K.B. Rohan Setty, CEO, who will also be the torch bearer for our future growth of the Company.

“The term “Satya Nag Champa” was coined by Late Shri K. N. Satyam Setty, a pioneer in the manufacture of traditional masala incense in India. During the early 1960s, while developing a unique incense blend based on the fragrance of Champa flowers and other blended fragrances,he adopted the name “Satya” from his own name, Satyam, signifying truth and authenticity. The word “Nag” was derived from his father’s name, Nagaiah, while “Champa” referred to the principal floral note used in the fragrance composition.

The resulting name “Satya Nag Champa” was used to identify the distinctive incense blend that later became internationally renowned. The product gained widespread popularity during the late 1960s and 1970s, well before the incorporation of the present business entities,and became one of the most recognized Indian incense products across the world.”

What began as a passion for preserving India's textile heritage has evolved into a growing fashion enterprise working with artisan clusters across multiple craft regions of India.

company_description: Mokalbari Tea Estate is situated on the South bank of the Brahmaputra River in Upper Assam. The name MOKALBARI traces its origin to words “MOKAL” and “BARI”. The word MOKAL stands for a special variety of tall bamboos having thick diameters of 12″ or more while the word BARI signifies a specific location or garden. Thus, the composite word MOKALBARI carries the meaning of a garden of a special variety of thick and tall bamboo trees In the second half of the 19th century a British Planter was curious to know as to what natural factor contributed to this abundant growth of this variety of bamboo trees in the area. He ultimately discovered that the Brahmaputra River originating from the glacier in the south east of the Lake Mansarowar in Tibet would bring from the hills of Tibet profuse sandyloam soil along its down flow that washed regularly its Southern bank. As an experienced planter, he understood that the continuous deposition of sandyloam in the area was the ideal topography for tea plantation. In 1876 he uprooted the “MOKAL” bamboo trees and started a tea plantation and named the garden as Mokalbari Tea Estate. Thus, we started manufacturing top quality Assam Orthodox and CTC Teas as early as in 1876. Our garden is one of the largest tea estates in the world having a sown area of 1022.03 hectares and producing 2.00 million kgs teas annually with the well trained labour force of 1600. Mokalbari has two running factories capable of producing 2.5 million kgs. of both CTC and Orthodox varieties. Kanois took over the Mokalbari Tea Estate in early 20th century. Over the years with the experience obtained and expertise achieved through generations. Kanois have nurtured this Estate to become one of the finest producing estates in India. The existing promoters acquired the companies Mokalbari Kanoi Tea Estate Pvt. Ltd and Goneshbari Tea Estate Pvt. Ltd in 2011. The distinction of our estate lies in producing TIPPY GOLDEN TEAS, which forms the base of the top East Frisian Blends. At Mokalbari we have developed a particular species of tea bushes, the green leaves of which are essential for production of what is known as GOLDEN TIPPY TEAS. The secret of this development has attained refinement and improvement with the passage of time. The Golden Tippy Teas manufactured in the estate have earned the distinction for their full- bodied, strong liquor, aroma, smooth and malty flavor and rich taste. All these subscribe to the legendary reputation that Mokalbari enjoys today, so much so that in European markets such teas are sold by the name of our garden only. We know and understand tea, we are alert to the great deal of care to be taken from the stage of plucking two leaves and a bud right up to packing and shipping in a manner that will ensure highest quality of flavor and liquor as well as their retention till a cup of this tea is put before a tea connoisseur. Mokalbari Group has three Tea Estates spread over 800 hectares of area under tea, producing 2.00 million Kgs annually with the well trained labour force of 1600. Buwch is an AI-powered B2B luxury footwear manufacturing and technology platform headquartered in Delhi, India. Founded in 2015, the company has evolved from a domestic eCommerce operation into a vertically integrated manufacturing enterprise serving footwear brands across India, the UAE, UK, Europe, the USA, and South East Asia.

What Buwch Does

Buwch occupies a unique position in the global footwear supply chain — one that no competitor currently holds. Unlike sourcing agents, marketplaces, or buying houses, Buwch assumes complete ownership of the manufacturing process. The company directly procures all raw materials including leather, soles, hardware, and components, develops proprietary molds and patterns, and distributes technical specifications to a curated network of contract manufacturers selected exclusively for their production capabilities. Factories do not supply materials or make independent sourcing decisions — they execute Buwch's manufacturing instructions under rigorous quality supervision, functioning as contractual production partners rather than autonomous suppliers.
This structure gives Buwch full control over cost, quality, lead time, and product consistency, while remaining factory-independent — never reliant on any single production facility. The result is a manufacturing model that combines the speed and flexibility of a technology platform with the accountability and quality standards of a premium manufacturer.

Leadership
Rohit Kashyap — Managing Director brings over a decade of hands-on experience in footwear B2B operations, export compliance, raw material procurement, and manufacturing quality assurance. Our Story — From Muddy Ponds to Your Plate
In the gentle wetlands of Mithila, Bihar - where rivers thread through fields and the land whispers ancient tales - a humble aquatic seed began its journey more than two centuries ago. This seed, known as Mithila Makhana (or fox nut), was first cultivated in the ponds of Madhubani and surrounding areas of what we call Mithilanchal today. 

For generations, local farmers - many from marginalized communities - embraced the laborious art of makhana cultivation. They harvested the floating seeds from ponds, carefully dried and roasted them, turning murky pond produce into crisp, nutrient-rich treats. 

Over time, Mithila’s makhana - with its soft crunch, subtle nutty flavour and wholesome goodness - carved out a place of respect. It became a cultural marker: one of the “three proud identities” of Mithila, alongside pond and fish.

In 2022, this legacy was formally honoured: Mithila Makhana received a Geographical Indication tag (GI tag), recognising its unique origin and guaranteeing its authenticity. 

Why Mithila Naturals Exists
At Mithila Naturals, we believe such a legacy deserves more than local plates - it deserves to travel far and wide, to kitchens and snack times everywhere. We are born out of that conviction.

We unite individuals with deep respect for tradition, eye for quality and a passion for sharing authentic flavour. Our goal: to bring the soul of Mithila’s wetlands and the hands of its farmers to every snack lover’s plate.

That’s why we source only premium-quality Mithila Makhana, grown in the traditional ponds and wetlands of Madhubani, Darbhanga, and nearby districts - regions that together contribute a major share of Bihar’s makhana production. 

We don’t stop at plain fox nuts. We take that heritage seed and craft it into a range of gourmet delights: flavoured makhana, crunchy snacks, indulgent makhana kheer, rustic cookies - each infused with the pure, earthy spirit of Mithila.

What Makes Our Products Special
Guaranteed Origin & Authenticity
Thanks to the GI-tagged status of Mithila Makhana, you can be confident that what you’re tasting is the genuine article - not just any “fox nut,” but one rooted in centuries of tradition from the wetlands of Mithilanchal. 

Quality, Taste and Soul
We honour traditional cultivation and processing - that means makhana harvested from ponds, carefully dried and popped, preserving its natural nutrients and subtle taste. The result: snacks and sweets that are wholesome, crunchy and full of heritage.

From Tradition to Table
What was once a humble pond harvest is now transformed into gourmet treats that fit modern lifestyles. Whether it’s a hearty makhana kheer, a crunchy flavored snack, or a rustic cookie, you get the richness of Mithila in every bite.

Supporting Farmers, Preserving Heritage
By sourcing directly from the very region where makhana’s story began, we support local communities and help keep alive a traditional craft that ties generations and geography together.

Our Promise
Mithila Naturals isn’t just a brand. It’s a journey — from the ponds of Madhubani, across generations of farmers, to your kitchen table. We promise to stay true to the roots: authentic makhana, crafted with care, wrapped in the spirit of Mithila, and delivered as quality gourmet delights.

When you taste our makhana snacks, kheer or cookies, you’re not just eating something tasty. You’re experiencing centuries of tradition, care, culture — a snack with a story.
